subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs generator PR should remain the canonical implementation for this issue?
rationale: Current main still lacks the requested behavior, but two overlapping open PRs implement it with different proof and merge states, so automation should not create or choose a replacement without maintainer intent.

options.title: Refresh and land the stronger sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path after conflict resolution, regeneration, and current-main proof.

options.title: Repair the same-author closing PR
options.body: Have https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 address its proof and formatter concerns, then close or supersede the sibling path.

options.title: Start a new narrow replacement
options.body: Close both overlapping branches only if maintainers decide neither branch is a good base for the generator/check implementation.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land the stronger sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path after conflict resolution, regeneration, and current-main proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work touched the same generated SecretRef docs surface and is the best available routing signal among the history owners.
